name: Bike Mobility Services (BMS)
note: European bike-leasing company whose brands are Lease a Bike, BusinessBike and B2Bike. Formerly within Pon.Bike; in 2023 Pon sold a 49% stake to Volkswagen Financial Services AG (part of the Volkswagen AG group) and the parties hold joint control (EU merger case M.11321). No single parent, so parentId is null.
